title: Carmovirus
source:
{{Short description|Defunct genus of viruses}}
{{Use dmy dates|date=April 2017}}

'''''Carmovirus''''' was a genus of [[virus]]es. The genus was split in 2015 into three genera, each retaining -''carmovirus'' as part of their name:<ref name=proposal >{{cite web |vauthors=Scheets K, White KA, Rubino L, Martelli G, Rochon D |title=Divide the genus ''Carmovirus'' into three new genera: ''Alphacarmovirus'', ''Betacarmovirus'', and ''Gammacarmovirus''. |url=https://ictv.global/ictv/proposals/2015.007a-rP.A.v1.split_Carmovirus.pdf |publisher=International Committee on Taxonomy of Viruses (ICTV) |date=3 June 2015|access-date=25 May 2021 |language=en}}</ref><ref name=ICTV >{{cite web |title=Virus Taxonomy: 2020 Release |url=https://ictv.global/taxonomy |publisher=International Committee on Taxonomy of Viruses (ICTV) |date=March 2021 |access-date=25 May 2021}}</ref>

* ''[[Alphacarmovirus]]''
* ''[[Betacarmovirus]]''
* ''[[Gammacarmovirus]]''

These genera are in the same family, ''[[Tombusviridae]]'', as the original genus and are more specifically in the subfamily ''[[Procedovirinae]]''. The following species were assigned to ''Carmovirus'' and are, as of 2020, placed within ''Procedovirinae'' but not assigned to a genus:<ref name=proposal /><ref name=ICTV />

* ''[[Ahlum waterborne virus]]''
* ''[[Bean mild mosaic virus]]''
* ''[[Cucumber soil-borne virus]]''
* ''[[Weddel waterborne virus]]''
